description: 3-page Letter, TimesRoman 10.5. Pages 1-2 have a text layer; page 3 (signature page) is an image-only scan with a client block (signature/name/date lines) and a firm signature line. Document has plenty of text overall, so the scan warning does not fire.
note: Expected fields on page 3 are true ground truth but invisible to a text-layer detector: they should show up as FN. A good detector should at least flag the text-less page.
